main_text.p: landiæ terrarum pariter ac hominum omnis notitia periit circa A. C.1416. neque hactenus reperiri potuit: nam quæ hodie Gronlandia àqva ta mca[?] ho dierna Gron. landia differt appellatur, hominibus destituta & alia regio est. Causam referunt tum in pestilentiam quandam, tum in glaciem ex mari Tartarico tempestatibus eje-ctam, quæ omnes in Gronlandia additus obstruxit. Unde quidam Gronlandos vel pestilentiâ extinctos putant, vel litoribus desertis ad inte-riora & remotiora, ac ut Hugo Grotius voluit, in ipsam Americam septentrionalem migrasse putant.
Quod nunc in Italia Neapolitanum vocatur regnum, olim Sicilia cis Farum sive Fretum; insula vero, Sicilia trans Farum dicebatur.

page.notes: The left margin note consists of six short lines ("àqva ta", "mca ho", "dierna", "Gron.", "landia", "differt"), transcribed as one note; "mca" and the first word are doubtful. The "inté" in "ad interiora" carries a stray mark, read as "inte-riora". The right edge shows fragments of the neighbouring page and is excluded. The catchword "Ca-" is at the lower right.
